title: /v/ The Musical IX
notes:
/v/ the Musical IX - Ultimate Battle Pass Edition With Exclusive Ethereum NFTs & TikTok Influencer Cameos

Ninth entry of 4chan's /v/ - Video Games forum user collaboration, /v/ the Musical. Contains popular music & scores covers parodying the video game industry and 4chan's culture.

Digital release. All six albums were released on bandcamp, but merely as placeholders to host mega download links that also includes the DLC bonus disc separated into two categories; original songs that were unfinished or disqualified, and alternate recordings and mixes.

Track formats are FLAC (1 to 7, 9 to 35, 37 to 66, 68 to 99, 101 to 149, 150 to 157, 161, 162, 163, 166, 167, 168, 170, 172, 173, 174, 176 to 184, 186, 187, 189 to 203), MP3-VBR (8, 36, 67, 150, 158, 171, 185, 188, 204, 205, 206), MP3-320kbps (100, 159, 160, 165, 175) & MP3-192kbps (164, 169).
